templates.name: Displaced Settlement Refugee
templates.description: Fleeing surface fallout or raider incursions, seeking protection in exchange for labor.

templates.name: Wasteland Caravan Trader
templates.description: Passing merchant with pack animals and scrap trade inventory, staying for brief negotiations.

templates.name: Warlord Outpost Defector
templates.description: Former combatant or technician seeking asylum with valuable intelligence.

templates.name: Enclave Diplomatic Envoy
templates.description: Formal delegation dispatched to negotiate non-aggression or mutual trade treaties.

templates.name: Solitary Wasteland Exile
templates.description: Loner outcast cast out of distant vault, wary of authority but possessing rare survival skills.
